text:
Ana Rodrigues: opened PR to tweak KMS rotation playbook + audit-log hook for secrets provisioning. needs sec eyes before EOW. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821
Raju Patel: skimming — what's the migration plan for existing keys? any downtime?
Ana Rodrigues: no downtime; script schedules rolling rewrap + background re-encrypt. snippet:
```
./scripts/kms/rotate_keys.sh --dry-run
```
Maria Chen: I'll take a look today. tagging @security-owners. do we need doc updates for SOC2 scope?
Ana Rodrigues: yes, will file docs ticket after merge.
CI Bot: build failed — lint error in rotate_keys.sh line 42
Ana Rodrigues: fixing lint now, pushing small patch
Maria Chen: LGTM on logic once CI green. left one comment about logging level
Raju Patel: small question on auditlog schema — do we append a field or reuse existing event_type?
Ana Rodrigues: appending `key_rotation.v2` so it won't collide
Samir (deploy-bot): adding label `deploy-blocker:security` per policy
Maria Chen: approved. can someone merge when green? prefer end-of-day rollout window
Ana Rodrigues: will merge after CI passes, thanks :thumbsup:
